named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: SELECT new br.edu.ifpb.pweb3.javerna.model.dto.ExpedicaoResumo( e.codigo, e.titulo, c.nomeOficial, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao) FROM Expedicao e JOIN e.caverna c WHERE e.inicioPrevisto >= :dataInicio AND e.terminoPrevisto <= :dataFim AND e.situacao = :situacao ORDER BY e.inicioPrevisto

named-query.name: Expedicao.buscarDetalhes
named-query.query: SELECT new br.edu.ifpb.pweb3.javerna.model.dto.ExpedicaoDetalhes( e.id, e.codigo, e.titulo, e.objetivo, c.nomeOficial, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.orcamentoAprovado, e.custoRealizado, e.quantidadeMaximaParticipantes, e.situacao, e.cancelamentoEmergencial) FROM Expedicao e JOIN e.caverna c WHERE e.id = :id

named-query.name: ParticipacaoExpedicao.listarResumos
named-query.query: SELECT new br.edu.ifpb.pweb3.javerna.model.dto.ParticipanteResumo( p.pessoa.id, p.pessoa.nome, p.papel) FROM ParticipacaoExpedicao p WHERE p.expedicao.id = :id ORDER BY p.pessoa.nome, p.pessoa.id

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.listarPorExpedicao
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM ColetaCientifica c JOIN FETCH c.setor JOIN FETCH c.pesquisadorResponsavel WHERE c.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId ORDER BY c.dataHora

named-query.name: Equipamento.listarDisponiveisNoPeriodo
named-query.query: SELECT eq FROM Equipamento eq WHERE eq.situacaoOperacional = br.edu.ifpb.pweb3.javerna.model.enums.SituacaoOperacional.DISPONIVEL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT u FROM UtilizacaoEquipamento u WHERE u.equipamento = eq AND u.dataHoraRetirada <= :fim AND COALESCE(u.dataHoraDevolucao, u.previsaoDevolucao) >= :inicio ) ORDER BY eq.nome

named-query.name: Amostra.listarPorColeta
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Amostra a WHERE a.coleta.id = :coletaId ORDER BY a.codigoCampo

named-query.name: PlanoSeguranca.baixarMapa
named-query.query: SELECT p.mapaRota FROM PlanoSeguranca p WHERE p.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId

named-query.name: AutorizacaoAmbiental.baixarArquivo
named-query.query: SELECT a.arquivoAssinado FROM AutorizacaoAmbiental a WHERE a.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId

named-query.name: RelatorioFinal.baixarArquivo
named-query.query: SELECT r.arquivoCompleto FROM RelatorioFinal r WHERE r.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId
